items.text: Biohackers say they can improve the body and brain by making small, careful changes to daily habits. In the past, this idea was popular mainly among wealthy businesspeople and top athletes; however, it has now become a large industry. Many companies sell supplements, special treatments, and unusual devices that promise better health and a longer life. One family promotes biohacking online and says it began as a way to survive serious health problems. They treat the body like a machine that people can measure and improve. At clinics in New York, clients can try new methods, such as short electric exercise sessions. The business grows fast, and new centers open in different places. However, some experts feel concerned because many methods lack strong scientific proof . They warn that some treatments may not be safe. Even so, many customers hope these services can slow aging and give them more time. Difficult words: promote (to tell people about something and try to make them like it or buy it), lack (to not have enough of something), proof (facts that show something is true). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Biohackers want to improve their body and brain with small changes in daily life. In the past, rich people and top athletes tried this idea. Now, many companies sell products and treatments , and the business grows fast. One family shares their story online. They say health problems pushed them to try biohacking. They treat the body like a machine and use tests and special exercises. In New York, a doctor offers short electric workouts and other services. He opens more centers because many people show interest. Some experts feel worried because there is little scientific proof . They say some methods may be unsafe. Still, many people believe biohacking can slow aging and help them live longer. Difficult words: treatment (medical care to help someone get better), workout (time when you do exercise to make your body stronger or healthier), proof (facts which show something is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Some people try to make their bodies and brains better. They call this biohacking. They make small changes in food, sleep, and exercise . In the past, only rich people and top sports stars do this. Now many people try it. One family talks about biohacking on the internet. They say that they start because of health problems. They use tests and short electric exercises. A doctor in New York opens centers for this work. Many people go there. Some experts say that this idea has risks . Nobody really knows if biohacking works. But many people believe it and want to live a long life. Difficult words: brain (the organ inside your head which helps you think and feel), exercise (physical activity), risk (a chance that something bad may happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

James Van Der Beek, the well-known star of the 1990s TV drama Dawson’s Creek, died at the age of 48 after a long battle with cancer. His wife shared the sad news on social media and said he faced his final days with courage , faith, and grace. Many fans and actors wrote messages about his strong influence on their lives and careers. After his death, a GoFundMe page started to raise money for his widow and their six children. The page reached more than 200,000 dollars in less than one hour. In 2024, he told the public about his colorectal cancer after a routine colonoscopy found the disease. He said he wanted to focus on his health and treatment. Van Der Beek became famous for his role as Dawson Leery, a young man with big dreams. The show made him a teen star. Later, he acted in over 60 films and TV shows. Difficult words: courage (the strength to face danger, pain, or fear), colorectal (related to the large intestine), colonoscopy (a medical test where a doctor looks inside your large intestine with a small camera). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

James Van Der Beek, the star of the TV show Dawson’s Creek, died at 48 after a cancer diagnosis. His wife shared the news online and said he showed courage and faith in his last days. Many fans and actors wrote kind messages and spoke about his influence on their lives. People started a GoFundMe page to raise money for his wife and six children. The page collected more than 200,000 dollars in less than one hour. In 2024, he told fans about his cancer after doctors found it during a checkup. He said he wanted to work on his health and get treatment . He became famous as Dawson Leery in the 1990s. Later, he acted in many movies and TV shows. Difficult words: courage (the power to deal with dangerous or bad situations), faith (when you believe in something), t reatment (medical care). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

James Van Der Beek is a TV star from the show Dawson’s Creek. He has cancer . He is 48 years old. His wife shares sad news online. She says he is brave in his last days. Many fans write kind words about him and his life. People start a page to raise money for his family. The page gets a lot of money very fast. He has a wife and six children. He talks about his cancer and his health. He is famous for his role as Dawson. He acts in many movies and TV shows. People know him as a teen star. Difficult words: cancer (a very bad disease), brave (not afraid), raise (to get money for something special). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Qatar celebrates National Sports Day on the second Tuesday of February each year. It is a public holiday, and many businesses close for the day. The government wants people to focus on health and take part in sports instead of just watching them. In recent years, Qatar has become a major center for international sport and has hosted large events such as the football World Cup. However, on this day, citizens and residents don’t sit and cheer. They join activities such as running, football, cricket, yoga, and long walks. The royal family, ministries, and private companies also take part. The day is not only about fun. It is a response to the problem of obesity among adults and children. The government has invested in parks, including air-conditioned spaces, to support exercise even in summer. National Sports Day sends a clear message that an active life is important for public health. Difficult words: major (very important or big), citizen (a person who legally belongs to a country), air-conditioned (cooled with a machine that makes the air inside a building cold). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Qatar has National Sports Day every year on the second Tuesday of February. It is a public holiday and many businesses close. The government wants people to think about health and do sports. Qatar hosts many big international sports events. But on this day, people don’t just watch sports. They take part in many activities. Families run, walk, play football, cricket, or do yoga. The royal family, government offices, and companies also join the activities. The day also helps with a health problem in the country, where many adults and children have obesity . The government builds parks and sports areas so people can exercise, even in summer. The goal is to help people live a more active and healthy life. Difficult words: public holiday (a special day when most people don’t work), host (to organize an event), obesity (when your body is too heavy). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Qatar has National Sports Day every year in February. It is a holiday. People do not go to work. The country wants people to think about health and sport. Qatar has many big sports events . But on this day, people do not only watch sports. They play football, run, walk, and do yoga. Families, children, and leaders join the fun. The country has a health problem. Many people are very overweight . The government builds parks for sports. People do sports and spend time together. The day helps people live a healthy life. Difficult words: health (how well you feel in your body and mind), event (an organized activity), overweight (heavier than is good for the body). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

European leaders discuss new rules to limit social media use for children. The head of the European Commission shows support for an EU age limit like the new Australian law. In France, the government plans a ban for children under 15 from September. The president supports this plan. Spain and some other countries are also considering similar actions. Some governments want to ask for parental consent or limit access to certain platforms. Many politicians say social media can harm children’s health. They talk about sleep problems, poor attention, and weak concentration . They believe platforms make a profit from child use and should change their systems. New rules may force companies to check age and take more responsibility. An expert in media law doesn’t support a full ban. He says children have communication rights and need contact with friends. Instead of a ban, he wants governments to control company business models and reduce addictive design. He believes strong regulation is better than a ban. Difficult words: consent (permission to do something), concentration (the ability to think carefully about one thing for some time), addictive (something that makes you want to use or do it again and again). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many European countries are thinking about limits on social media for children. The head of the EU supports a common age limit. In France, the government plans a ban for children under 15, and the president supports this idea. Some other countries want parents to agree or want to limit some apps. Politicians say social media can hurt children’s health. They say it can cause sleep problems and poor attention . They think companies make money from young users and don’t keep them safe. New laws can make companies check age and change their systems. An expert says a ban is not the best thing to do. He says children need communication with friends. He wants stricter rules for companies instead. Difficult words: common (the same for everyone), ban (an official rule that says you cannot do something), attention (careful thinking or focus on something ). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Some countries in Europe want new rules for social media. They want to stop children under 15 or 16 from using some apps. France plans a ban soon. The president likes this plan. Other countries think about new rules, too. Many leaders say that social media is bad for child health . They say that it can cause sleep problems. Also, children have problems focusing on one thing for a long time. Experts think that companies make money from children. Another expert does not like a ban. He says that children need contact with friends. He wants new rules for companies, not a full ban. He says that better rules can keep children safe. Difficult words: rule (what you can or cannot do), ban (an official stop), health (how well your body and mind feel and work). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The luxury group that owns Gucci reported results for the last quarter of the year that were better than many people expected. This was the first quarter under a new CEO, who aims to bring stability after several difficult years. The company has faced close attention from investors because of debt and lower profits since 2022, after Gucci’s old-fashioned style stopped attracting buyers. The new CEO said he already sees improvement at Gucci. Group sales reached about 3.4 billion dollars, which was only slightly lower than last year and stronger than forecasts . Gucci sales also fell less than expected, helped by new products, especially handbags. Because of this, company shares have risen strongly since the new leader took charge. Even so, serious problems remain. The company has closed many stores and plans more closures as part of cost cuts. Annual operating income is now far below its level from a few years ago. The group must still work hard to compete with rivals during a global slowdown in luxury spending. Difficult words: improvement (a change that makes something better), forecast (a statement about what will probably happen in the future), operating income (money a company makes from its normal business activities). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The owner of Gucci shared its sales results for the last quarter . The numbers looked better than people expected. This was the first quarter with a new boss, who wants to fix problems after years of falling profit s. Investors watch the company closely because debt grows, and Gucci’s old style is no longer attractive to many buyers. The new boss says things are getting better. Sales fall only a little, and new bags help bring buyers back. Company shares went up when the new boss started. Still, the situation stays difficult. The company is closing many shops and plans more cuts to save money. In 2025, the company made less money than before. The group now tries to work hard even though the market is slow. Difficult words: q uarter (three months in a year), profit (money you have after you pay all costs), debt (money that you owe to someone). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The company which owns Gucci talks about its sales . The numbers look better than many people think. A new boss now leads the company. He wants to help it after hard years. Gucci has big problems. Its old fashion style does not feel popular now. The new boss says that Gucci is changing. Sales go down only a little. New bags help bring buyers. Many people buy parts of the company after this news. But the company still has problems. It closes many shops. It plans to close more shops. It makes much less money than before. People do not buy luxury things so much now. The company now tries to stay strong. Difficult words: sale (when you sell something), popular (when many people like something or someone), luxury (expensive and nice to have). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A group of nineteen Buddhist monks finished a 108-day walk across the United States and arrived in Washington. They started in Texas and walked more than 3,700 kilometres to share a message of peace and calm focus. Many people followed their journey online and came to see them in towns and cities along the way. The monks, dressed in orange robes , also travelled with their rescue dog. Large crowds welcomed them in Washington. About 3,500 people gathered at a university hall and stayed quiet to show respect. During the long walk, the group faced danger. A truck hit their support vehicle on a highway. Two monks were hurt, and one monk lost his leg, but later joined the group again in a wheelchair. The monks say their walk is a spiritual act, not a political protest. They teach meditation and encourage people to find peace in their daily lives. The number 108 is sacred in their tradition and stands for spiritual completion and wholeness . Difficult words: robe (a long, loose piece of clothing that covers the body), gather (to come together in one place), sacred (very special in a religious way), wholeness (being complete, with nothing missing). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Nineteen Buddhist monks walk across the United States for 108 days and arrive in Washington. They start in Texas and travel more than 3,700 kilometres. They want to share a message of peace and calmness. Many people follow them online and meet them in different cities. The monks wear orange clothes and travel with a rescue dog. Many people welcome them in Washington. About 3,500 people sit quietly in a large hall to show respect. During the trip, a truck hits their car. Two monks get hurt, and one monk loses his leg. Later, he joins the group again in a wheelchair . The monks say they don’t plan a political protest. They teach meditation and ask people to live in peace every day. The number 108 has special meaning in Buddhism. Difficult words: monk (a man who lives with other religious people and follows rules), peace (a state with no war, fighting, or stress), wheelchair (a chair with wheels for a person who cannot walk). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Nineteen monks walk across the United States for 108 days. They start in Texas and go to Washington. They walk more than 3,700 kilometres. They talk about peace and a calm mind. Many people watch them online and meet them on the road. The monks wear orange clothes and have a dog. Many people wait for them in Washington. About 3,500 people sit very quietly in a big hall . During the walk, a big car hits their car. Two monks get hurt. One monk loses his leg. Later, he comes back in a wheelchair . The monks teach meditation. They ask people to live in peace every day. The number 108 is special in Buddhism. Difficult words: peace (a state with no war or fight), hall (a large room), wheelchair (a chair for a person who cannot walk). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Prince and Princess of Wales spoke after new information appeared about Jeffrey Epstein. A palace spokesperson said they feel deeply concerned and they think mainly about the victims. This is the first time they spoke in public about this issue, and many people paid close attention to their words. The statement comes after new documents from the United States brought more details about Epstein and about Prince Andrew’s past connection with him. Andrew already lost his royal titles and moved from his home. The new information creates more pressure on the royal family, because they don’t know what details may appear next. The timing of the statement also links to Prince William’s official visit to Saudi Arabia. Experts say the palace wants to show care for the victims before this important trip. The short message doesn’t give any names, but it shows concern and tries to protect the work and role of the future king during a sensitive moment. Difficult words: attention (when people watch, listen, or think about something carefully), statement (an official message), pressure (strong force to act). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Prince and Princess of Wales spoke after new documents about Jeffrey Epstein appeared. A palace spokesperson says they feel very concerned and they think about the victims . This is their first public comment on this issue, so many people notice it. The news also brings more attention to Prince Andrew and his past friendship with Epstein. Andrew lost his royal titles and left his home. The new documents cause worry in the royal family because more details may still come out. The news came just before Prince William travels to Saudi Arabia for an important visit. Royal experts say the palace wants to calm the situation and show care for the victims. The message stays short and doesn’t name anyone, but it sends a clear signal . Difficult words: victim (a person who suffers harm), attention (when people watch or listen carefully), signal (a clear sign). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Prince and Princess of Wales speak about new information on Jeffrey Epstein. A palace spokesperson says that they feel worried and they think about the victims . This is the first time they talk about this in public. The news brings more talk about Prince Andrew and his past link to Epstein. Andrew loses his titles and leaves his home. People ask more questions, and the royal family feels stressed. The message comes before Prince William travels to Saudi Arabia. Experts say that the family wants to show care and calm people. The message stays short and simple, but many people listen to it. Difficult words: spokesperson (a person who speaks for a group or organization), victim (the person who is hurt), link (when two people share things or ideas). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the 17th century, Isaac Newton explained that gravity causes tides. The Moon pulls most strongly on the side of Earth closest to it, creating a tidal bulge . A second bulge forms on the opposite side because the Earth and Moon orbit a shared center of mass. As Earth spins, different places move into and out of these bulges, causing two high tides and two low tides every day. The Sun also affects tides. When the Sun and Moon line up during a full or new moon, we get strong spring tides. When they are at right angles, we get weaker neap tides. Local geography affects how strong tides are – wide, shallow bays can make tides more extreme. Tidal forces are even stronger on other moons and planets. Jupiter’s moon Io has powerful tidal heating that causes volcanic activity. Over time, Earth will become tidally locked to the Moon, always showing the same face. But that won’t happen for billions of years, long after the Sun is gone. Difficult words: tidal bulge (a rise in sea level caused by gravity), neap (a tide just after the first or third quarters of the moon when there is the least difference between high and low water). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Moon and the Sun cause tides on Earth. The Moon pulls on Earth’s water, making it rise in two places – on the side closest to the Moon and on the opposite side. As the Earth spins , different areas move into these bulges . This causes two high and two low tides every day. The Sun also affects tides. When the Sun and Moon are in line, we get stronger tides called spring tides. When they are at an angle , we get weaker tides. Some places have bigger tides than others depending on the shape of the land. Other planets and moons have very strong tides, too. One moon of Jupiter, called Io, even has volcanoes because of tides. One day, Earth may always face the Moon, but that will take billions of years. Difficult words: spin (to turn around), bulge (a rounded swelling of a flat surface), angle (the space between two lines or surfaces at the point at which they touch each other). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Moon and the Sun make the ocean go up and down. This is called tides. The Moon pulls on Earth’s water and makes it rise in two places. As the Earth turns, these places move. We get two high tides and two low tides every day. The Sun also helps make tides. When the Moon and Sun are in a line, the water goes up more. When they are not in a line, the water does not move as much. Some places have big tides, and some places have small ones. On other planets and moons , tides can be very strong. One moon even has hot volcanoes because of tides. Difficult words: rise (to go up), moon (a rock which goes around a planet). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thousands of Romanian teachers and education staff protested against government plans to cut education funding. The government, led by Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan, approved austerity measures to reduce the budget deficit . They include a 10% cut in the salary fund for public institutions, which teachers say will harm schools and universities. Protesters argued that education already receives less money, and university leaders warned that these cuts will limit development and research. Some compared Romania to Ukraine, where education spending has increased even during the war, and questioned why Romania does the opposite. Teachers’ unions have threatened to strike if the measures go ahead. They also started a petition to collect 100,000 signatures to repeal the government plans. The new budget with these measures will be sent to parliament by 20 February, and unions may announce strike dates for March or June. Difficult words: austerity (a time when the government cuts spending to save money), deficit (a situation when the government spends more money than it has), repeal (to cancel a law or rule). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many teachers in Romania protested because the government wants to cut money for schools and universities. The Prime Minister’s government plans to reduce the salary fund by 10%. Teachers said education already has little money, and blocking university income will make it hard to pay salaries and support research. University leaders agreed that the cuts would hurt education. Some compared Romania to Ukraine, where teachers’ pay is going up even during the war. Teachers’ unions said they may strike if the cuts happen. They also started a petition to get 100,000 signatures to stop the new rules. The government will send the new plan to parliament on 20 February. The protests show that teachers want the government to keep money for schools and protect the future of students. Difficult words: fund (money for a special purpose), block (to stop something from happening), salary (the money a person gets for their job), unions (groups that protect workers and speak for them). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many teachers in Romania are angry. The government wants to cut money for schools and universities. Teachers say that there is not enough money now, and cutting more will make teaching hard. Universities also lose money, which they use for research and pay. Some teachers compare Romania to Ukraine. Ukrainian teachers get more money than they do. Teachers may stop working if the cuts happen. Teachers’ groups ask people to sign a petition . It may help stop the cuts. The government will give the new plan to parliament on 20 February. Teachers want the government to keep money for schools and help students and teachers have a better future. Difficult words: research (a study to find new information), compare (to look at two or more things and see how similar or different they are), petition (an official paper where people write their name if they want to change something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This homemade sandwich bread is incredibly soft, with a thin and crispy crust that makes sandwiches taste even better. It is made with whole wheat flour, which gives it a rich flavor and fluffy texture without any artificial additives. The best part is that it is easy to make at home with simple ingredients like water, yeast, yogurt, vegetable oil, and two types of flour. The process requires a few steps, but the result is a delicious, fresh loaf worth the effort. To prepare the dough, mix the ingredients until there is no dry flour left. Let it rest for 30 minutes, then stretch and fold the dough to strengthen it. Repeat this process twice, allowing the dough to rise for about two hours. After shaping it into a loaf, let it rise again for an hour before baking. To achieve the perfect texture, score the top and bake with a cover for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 more minutes. Once baked, the bread should have a hollow sound when tapped, meaning it is perfectly done. The crust will be thin and crispy, while the inside will be incredibly soft. Difficult words: artificial (not natural or real), score (to cut or scratch a line or a surface), hollow (having a hole or space inside). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

This homemade sandwich bread is very soft, with a thin and crispy crust. It has whole wheat flour, which gives it a nice flavor and soft texture . There are only natural ingredients, which makes it easy to make at home. The ingredients include water, yeast, yogurt, oil, and two types of flour. The steps take some time, but the result is a fresh and tasty loaf. First, mix everything well and let the dough rest for 30 minutes. Stretch and fold the dough to make it stronger. Do this two times, then let the dough rise for two hours. Shape it into a loaf and let it rise again for one hour. Before baking, cut the top a little. Bake with a cover for 25 minutes, then without it for 10 more minutes. When baked, the bread makes a hollow sound if you tap on it. The crust is thin and crispy, and the inside is very soft. Let it cool before eating. This fresh bread is great for sandwiches or with butter. Difficult words: whole wheat (made from whole grains in their natural form), texture (how something feels to touch), hollow (empty inside). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This sandwich bread is soft inside. It has a thin, crispy crust . It has whole wheat flour, which makes it tasty. It is easy to make at home with just a few ingredients . You need water, yeast , yogurt, oil, and two types of flour. The steps take some time. But the bread is fresh and good. First, mix all the ingredients. Let the dough rest for 30 minutes. Then, pull and fold it to make it better. Do this two times, then wait for two hours. Make the dough into a loaf and wait for one more hour. Before baking, cut the top a little. Bake with a cover first, then without it. When the bread is ready, it makes a special sound when you tap on it. The crust is thin, and the inside is very soft. Let it cool before eating. This bread is good for sandwiches or with butter. Difficult words: crust (the hard outer part of bread), ingredient (one of the things in a recipe), yeast (a tiny organism which helps dough rise), dough (a soft, thick mixture to make bread or pizza). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Pakistan will take part in the T20 World Cup that starts on 7 February, but the team will not play its group match against India. The government gave permission for Pakistan to join the event, yet it said the team must not face India. This decision came after Bangladesh withdrew from the tournament because of safety fears related to travel. Scotland replaced Bangladesh. Tension between Pakistan and India has stayed high for more than a year, with political and military problems and no regular cricket series between them. Pakistan officials said they felt treated unfairly and wanted to show support for Bangladesh. The International Cricket Council warned that this choice could bring long-term problems for Pakistan cricket and for the tournament itself. Fans in Pakistan feel sad and disappointed because they want to see their team play India. Experts say the match matters greatly for world cricket because it brings huge audiences and money. Many worry that politics now threatens the future and fairness of major cricket events. Difficult words: permission (when someone says you can do something), withdraw (to leave or stop taking part), audience (the people who watch an event). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Pakistan joins the T20 World Cup, but it refuses to play against India, which is in the same group. The government allows the team to travel and compete, but it blocks the match with India. Bangladesh decided to leave the tournament because of safety worries. Scotland took Bangladesh’s place. Officials in Pakistan say relations with India remain very bad and unfair. They say India holds too much power in world cricket. Pakistan also says it wants to support Bangladesh. The ICC asks Pakistan to think again and warns that this decision can hurt cricket in Pakistan and around the world. Many fans in Pakistan feel unhappy because they love this famous match and want their team to play. This match would bring many people and a lot of money. Sadly, politics now hurts international cricket. Difficult words: refuse (to say no), tournament (a big sports competition with many matches), relation (the way people or countries feel and act toward each other). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Pakistan plays in the Cricket World Cup, but it does not play India. The government says yes to the tournament but no to that match. Bangladesh leaves the tournament because it does not feel safe. Scotland joins instead . Pakistan and India have many problems. They do not play each other often. Pakistan says that it wants to stand with Bangladesh. The cricket group ICC asks Pakistan to think again. Fans in Pakistan feel sad. They want to see this big match. This game brings many people and much money. Some experts worry that politics hurts world cricket. Difficult words: tournament (a big sports event with many matches), instead (in place of something else), fan (a person who really likes and supports a team or sport). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy have started; however, a strange problem has taken attention away from records and medals. Anti-doping officials are closely watching ski jumpers because some athletes may be trying to change their body shape in an unusual way. Reports say a few ski jumpers inject substances such as hyaluronic acid into their genitals to make them temporarily larger. They believe this can improve aerodynamics and help them jump farther. In ski jumping, body shape and balance are extremely important. Even very small changes can affect air flow and distance. Research shows that a change of just two centimeters can add several meters to a jump, which can decide who wins. The sport already has a history of cheating, including suit tampering at the 2025 World Ski Championships. Officials now worry that injections are harder to detect, which raises serious concerns about fairness and trust in the Olympic Games. Difficult words: anti-doping (rules and checks to stop athletes from using illegal drugs to win), genitals (private parts of the body used for sex or reproduction), aerodynamics (how air moves around objects). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy began with a strange problem in ski jumping. Anti-doping officials are checking athletes because some may inject substances into their genitals . They do this to change their body shape for a short time and hope it helps them jump farther. In ski jumping, small changes in shape matter a lot because they affect air flow and balance . Studies show that even a tiny change can make the jump several meters longer. This can change competition results. Ski jumping had cheating problems before, especially when athletes changed their suits. Officials are now worried because injections are much harder to find and control, which could harm trust in the Olympics. Difficult words: anti-doping (rules and checks which stop athletes from using illegal drugs to win), genitals (parts of the body used for sex or reproduction), balance (when you are steady and not falling). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Winter Olympics in Italy have a strange problem. Some ski jumpers may change their bodies to jump farther. Reports say that some athletes inject substances into their penises. They do this to make them bigger for a short time. They think that this helps them fly better in the air. In ski jumping, body shape is very important. Even small changes can help an athlete go farther. This sport already has cheating before, like changing suits. Now, officials worry because injections are hard to see. They want fair sport for everyone at the Olympics. Difficult words: inject (to put a liquid into the body with a thin metal instrument), shape (the form or way something looks), cheat (to do something unfair). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Hind Kabawat is Syria’s minister for social affairs and labour and the only woman in the country’s transitional government . She spoke openly about her worry that there are not enough women in power and said this was a mistake at the start of the transition. After years of war and dictatorship , the new government must show change and responsibility. Kabawat lived in exile for many years and now works with many women in her ministry. She says she doesn’t see herself as a symbol, but as someone who serves people. She rejects the idea that she is only there for show and says she needs real power, plans, and money to help people. Her work includes visiting camps where families live in poor conditions with little help. Violence between groups has hurt trust in the new leaders. Kabawat calls for patience and asks for dialogue and respect during Syria’s difficult move toward peace. Difficult words: transitional government (a temporary group that leads a country while it changes to a new system), dictatorship (a system where one person or group has all the power), exile (life away from the home country). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Hind Kabawat works as Syria’s minister. She is the only woman in the new government and questions why more women don’t hold high jobs. She says the country moves from war to peace, and leaders must accept mistakes and learn from them. Many people expect clear signs of change after years of conflict. Kabawat lived outside Syria for many years and now works inside the government. She hires many women. She wants real control over plans and money so she can help people. She says she doesn’t accept a role that exists only for show. She visits camps where families live in tents without enough help. She thanks people for their peaceful support and asks for patience , respect, and talks between all sides. Difficult words: question (to want to know something), peaceful (calm), patience (when you can wait and don’t get angry). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Researchers from a Swiss university sent a four-legged robot onto Mount Etna in Italy, one of the most active volcanoes in Europe. The goal is to collect gas data that can show changes in volcanic activity. This work helps scientists understand eruptions better and lowers danger because people don’t need to walk on unsafe ground with toxic gas and loose rock. The robot has cameras, sensors, and special tools that measure gas in the air. It can move across steep slopes, sand, and crater edges. It uses AI to decide how to move its legs and keep its balance. This system helps the robot react to the ground and choose safe steps in difficult places. During tests on the volcano, the robot completed several missions on its own with very high success. It found most of the test gas sources that researchers placed on purpose . The team hopes future missions can cover longer distances and work with even less human control, which could make volcano research safer and more effective. Difficult words: loose (not tight or not fixed in place), crater (a large hole at the top of a volcano), on purpose (done because you plan it). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Scientists from Switzerland use a robot dog on Mount Etna in Italy. The robot helps get information about gas from the volcano. This makes travel on rough land easier. Tests show the robot finishes most tasks alone and finds many gas sources. Researchers want the robot to travel farther in the future and work with less help. This technology may improve volcano research and protect human lives. Difficult words: human (a person), sensor (a tool for finding or noticing things), measure (to find out how much or how big something is). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The robot works alone most of the time and finds many gas spots . The team wants it to walk farther and help more in the future. This robot helps science and saves lives. Difficult words: volcano (a mountain which can send out fire, ash, or gas), danger (a situation when people can be hurt), spot (a place or small area). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Rome now asks tourists to pay a small fee to get close to the Trevi Fountain. From 2 February 2026, visitors pay 2 euros to walk down the steps near the water and throw a coin. People can still see the fountain for free from the square above, and the view stays clear for everyone. The city wants visitors to show more respect for the monument . City leaders say the main goal is crowd control, not profit. The Trevi Fountain often gets too crowded, and problems like pickpocketing happen there. The city already tested lines and time limits, and officials say this system worked well. Around ten million people waited in line last year, with very busy days in the summer. Tickets apply only during busy daytime hours, while late evening access stays free. The money will help care for historic sites and improve visits; however, Rome residents don’t pay the fee. City leaders say this plan supports better tourism and protects famous sites for the future. Difficult words: monument (an old or important building or place), pickpocketing (stealing money from someone’s pocket or bag in a crowd), resident (a person who lives in a place). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Rome now asks tourists to pay 2 euros to get close to the Trevi Fountain. Visitors pay the fee to walk near the water and throw a coin . People can still see the fountain for free from the square above, and the city keeps the view open. City leaders want fewer people near the fountain at the same time. Big crowds often cause problems like pickpocketing and fights. The city already uses lines and time limits, and officials say these rules help. Many people visit the fountain every year, especially in summer. The fee works only during busy daytime hours; people can still get close to the fountain for free in the evening. The city uses the money to care for historic places. People who live in Rome don’t pay any fee. The city hopes this plan makes visits calmer and more respectful . Difficult words: fee (money you pay for a service or to enter a place), pickpocketing (taking money from someone’s bag or pocket), respectful (when someone cares). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Difficult words: coin (small metal money), fountain (a place where water flows), control (to keep things how they should be). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Tens of thousands of people marched in cities in the Czech Republic to support President Petr Pavel. He refused to approve a new environment minister after the nominee showed a Nazi salute and shared Nazi items online. Many people filled the central squares in Prague, waved national and EU flags, and showed support for Ukraine. They also showed anger toward the prime minister and his government partners. The conflict grew stronger after the president said a government minister tried to blackmail him with warning messages. The nominee said his past actions showed bad taste, not belief, but many people said this behavior made him unfit for a top job. Speakers at the protests praised the president for clear values and strong leadership. Experts said the protests also showed wider public frustration with high prices, weak services, and political fights. The president thanked people for their peaceful action and asked for dialogue, but he kept his position. More protests are planned in the coming weeks. Difficult words: nominee (a person chosen for a job or position), blackmail (to threaten someone to get money or force them to do something), frustration (a feeling of anger or stress when things don’t work well). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Difficult words: refuse (to say no), nominee (a person chosen for a job or position), criticize (to say what is wrong with something or someone). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The APE, a three-wheeled mini truck, has been a beloved vehicle in Italy for decades. However, production at the factory in Tuscany ended in December 2024, leaving collectors and fans heartbroken. Many Italians have fond memories of the APE, including Crescenzo Langella, who even took it on his honeymoon. He describes driving it as a comforting experience, like being hugged by a loved one. Since its launch in 1948, the APE became a symbol of Italy’s economic growth, used by traders, farmers, and fishers. Enthusiasts like Crescenzo, who owns over 70 APE vehicles, are working to preserve them. He has set up a workshop near Milan to maintain these classic mini trucks. Although Italy’s passion for the APE has declined, production will continue in India, including an electric model. Some Italians feel betrayed by this change, but fans remain dedicated. Crescenzo, for example, is so devoted to the APE that he has arranged to be buried in one. Difficult words: fond (loving, caring), preserve (to keep something as it is), betrayed (felt abandoned or wronged). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Farmers and traders used it for work. Now, India will make the truck, including an electric version. Some Italians are upset, but fans like Crescenzo will never forget the APE. He even wants to be buried in one when he dies. Difficult words: three-wheeled (having three wheels), honeymoon (a holiday after a wedding), buried (put under the ground after death). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Difficult words: fan (a person who likes something very much), honeymoon (a holiday after a wedding), workshop (a room or building where workers make things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

English football clubs have done very well in the Champions League this year. Five of the eight teams in the last 16 come from the English Premier League, and a sixth team may join soon. The league has many strong clubs, and the matches are very hard and competitive . Players get used to fast and physical games, which helps them in Europe. Many teams also use set pieces like corners and long throws to score goals. The financial power of English clubs helps them get the best players and coaches. Even if English teams do well in early matches, they face problems later. They play many games in England without a winter break, while other European teams rest. This can make players tired when the most important matches start. Experts say big clubs from Spain, Germany, or France may have an advantage in the last rounds. English clubs can prepare well for European games, but winning the Champions League is still difficult. Difficult words: competitive (when you want to win or be the best), set piece (a special way to start the ball in football, like a free kick or corner), advantage (something that helps you win or do better than others). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Difficult words: join (to become part of a group or team), corner (when the ball goes out at the side of the goal and you hit it back from the corner area), coach (the person who teaches players in sports). Although Antarctica is protected by an international treaty, it is facing increasing threats due to economic interests. Scientists are studying the effects of climate change and pollution, while others are conducting research that raises global concerns. Recently, seismic surveys in the Weddell Sea uncovered an enormous oil reserve – over 500 billion barrels. This discovery could be worth trillions of dollars, making Antarctica a target for future drilling. While the Antarctic Treaty bans oil exploration, its rules could be challenged as economic and political pressures grow. Several countries claim parts of Antarctica, which could lead to possible disputes . Environmentalists warn that human activity, including climate change, overfishing, and pollution, is harming the continent. The treaty’s drilling ban will be reviewed in 2048, meaning it is not permanent. Many fear that economic interests will eventually override environmental protection. The need to enforce strict regulations and protect Antarctica has never been more urgent. Difficult words: seismic (related to vibrations in the Earth), dispute (a disagreement or argument), override (to use the authority to reject or cancel something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Scientists are studying pollution and climate change, but other research found something important – large amounts of oil under the Weddell Sea. There could be oil worth trillions of dollars, and many people worry that companies may want to drill there. The Antarctic Treaty says that oil drilling is not allowed, but countries will check this rule again in 2048. Many countries claim parts of Antarctica, which could cause problems. At the same time, climate change, pollution, and overfishing are already hurting the continent. Some people believe the treaty is strong enough to protect Antarctica. Others are scared that money and politics will win there too. Difficult words: treaty (a deal between countries), drill (to make a deep hole in the ground), claim (to formally say that something is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Difficult words: international (existing between countries; worldwide), pollution (dirty air, water, or land), drill (to make a deep hole in the ground). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Disney parks once offered an affordable family experience. In 1955, Disneyland tickets cost about 1 dollar for adults. Today, a one-day ticket can cost over 150 dollars on peak days. Annual passes at Disney World rose from about 829 dollars in 2015 to around 1,629 dollarsby 2025. Food prices also jumped. A Mickey ice cream bar that cost 2.75 dollars in 2009 now costs about 6.50. Disney adds more attractions and services, which raises costs. The company also uses demand-based pricing, so busy days are more expensive. Parks now bring Disney most of its income, while movies and TV earn less. Disney also sells many paid extras . Skipping lines with Lightning Lane can cost up to 449 dollars per day. Luxury hotel rooms can cost 3,500 dollars or more per night. These options target rich visitors. Many fans still love Disney, but they visit less often or save longer. Difficult words: affordable (easy to pay for), peak (the busiest or most popular time), extra (something more than the basic thing). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Annual passes almost doubled in ten years. Food and souvenirs cost more, too, like a 6.50-dollar ice cream bar or expensive Mickey ears. Disney builds new rides and has new services, which makes prices higher. Ticket prices change by date, so busy days cost more. Parks now bring Disney more money than movies or TV. Disney says higher costs and big projects cause price rises. Disney also has things like skip lines or expensive hotels. These extras can cost hundreds or thousands of dollars. Many fans still go, but they plan trips carefully or go less often. Difficult words: annual pass (a ticket you pay for once and use for a whole year), souvenir (something you buy to remember a place), skip line (when you go past people who are waiting and don’t wait). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
